Coefficient singularities prove the generic polynomial tail, rational-pole decay at integer \(r=\beta/(1-\beta)\), and exact polynomial truncation at \(A=0\). The full-state convergence condition is exactly \(|A|<1\), equivalent to \(0<s<2/(1-\beta)\); the boundary and supercritical cases fail because the base sequence does not converge.
